title: Managed Backup: protected usage rate
content:
For Managed Backup, the following tier basis defines protected usage rate.

## Tier basis

**Primary unit rate.** Standard primary usage rate in USD per primary protected GB-month unit before region factors; decimal.

| Contract tier | Primary unit rate |
| --- | --- |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB | 0.048 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 10 TB | 0.046 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 25 TB | 0.044 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 50 TB | 0.042 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 100 TB | 0.04 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 250 TB | 0.038 |

## Tier lookup

For the Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB tier, primary unit rate is 0.048.

## Hypothetical comparison

For a hypothetical choice between the smallest and largest listed tiers, primary unit rate differs: 0.048 for the smallest and 0.038 for the largest.
